literal: Do not admire at any time oneself; do not desire goodness-not-yielding action.
translation: Never indulge in self-admiration, and never desire to perform actions that do not yield any good.
modern: எக்காலத்திலும் தன்னைத்தானே வியந்து பாராட்டக் கூடாது; நன்மையைத் தராத செயல்களைச் செய்ய விரும்பக் கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet warns against two major self-destructive tendencies: vanity and unproductive action. The word 'வியவற்க' commands us not to praise or be conceited about ourselves, while 'எஞ்ஞான்றும்' emphasizes that this rule of humility applies at all times without exception. The second part uses 'நயவற்க' to warn against desiring or choosing to do 'நன்றி பயவா வினை', which refers to deeds that fail to produce any real benefit or goodness. Together, these instructions guide a person to remain humble and focus only on meaningful, ethical actions.
